name: VoxelGrid Mesh Generation
definition: Generates a triangle mesh from a set of voxels in a VoxelGrid that satisfy a specific condition or are identified by a list of IDs. It transforms a base cell mesh (wireframe or faceted) into world space for each selected voxel.
summary: VoxelGrid Mesh Generation constructs a combined triangle mesh from selected voxels by transforming base geometry into world space, producing a non-manifold, blocky mesh that differs from watertight Boolean voxel meshing.
